programme.title: Paranormal Activity

programme.title: Would You Rather

programme.title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

programme.title: Grease 2

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: The most memorable moments from movie history are ranked in this funny and exciting show with anecdotes from experts that will make you laugh and take you back to the most iconic, outrageous and unforgettable movie moments ever.

programme.title: Buying the Cow
programme.desc: A man (Jerry O'Connell) demonstrates his inability to commit after his longtime girlfriend (Bridgette L. Wilson) expresses interest in marriage.

programme.title: Wild Things
programme.desc: A Florida police officer investigates when two teens accuse a high-school guidance counselor of rape.

programme.title: The Professional
programme.desc: An Italian hit man (Jean Reno) in New York risks his life to protect an orphan girl (Natalie Portman) who captures his heart.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: A New York paleontologist (Bridget Fonda) goes to the backwoods of Maine and teams up with the local game warden (Bill Pullman) to stop a 35-foot killer crocodile.

programme.title: Lake Placid 2
programme.desc: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.

programme.title: Boa vs. Python
programme.desc: An FBI agent (David Hewlett) and a biologist (Jaime Bergman) release a specially bred serpent to hunt the gigantic snake that has been putting the squeeze on unwary humans.

programme.title: Nothing but the Truth
programme.desc: After writing an article that reveals the name of a covert CIA operative, a reporter (Kate Beckinsale) goes to jail to protect the identity of her story's source.

programme.title: The Principal
programme.desc: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

programme.title: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Ray (Dylan Walsh) sheds his dead-end life, rekindles a romance, then rids his town of a drug dealer.

programme.title: The Last Time
programme.desc: A foul-mouthed salesman (Michael Keaton) undergoes a transformation after beginning an affair with his protégé's fiancée (Amber Valletta).

programme.desc: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.

programme.desc: An alienated Pittsburgh police officer (Bruce Willis) and his new partner (Sarah Jessica Parker) on the River Rescue Squad hunt a serial killer.
